title: GIC and Coatue lead Anthropic's $30B Series G

sources.quote: We have raised $30 billion in Series G funding led by GIC and Coatue, valuing Anthropic at $380 billion post-money.
This round also includes a portion of the previously announced investments from Microsoft and NVIDIA.

explain: Singapore's GIC co-led, with Coatue, a $30 billion funding round for Anthropic at a $380 billion valuation. The amount shown is the whole round, which includes part of money Microsoft and Nvidia had already promised; GIC's own share was not disclosed.
